name: market-atlas
description: Interactive geographic explorer for Kalshi sports, politics, weather, and business markets.

scripts.build:worker:staging: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config XDG_CACHE_HOME=.wrangler/cache WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run --env staging --outdir dist/staging --minify
scripts.build:worker:production: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/config XDG_CACHE_HOME=.wrangler/cache WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production --outdir dist/production --minify
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:worker:staging && npm run build:worker:production
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run validate && npm run build:worker
scripts.predeploy:staging: npm run build:client && npm run validate && npm run check:deploy -- staging
scripts.predeploy:production: npm run build:client && npm run validate && npm run check:deploy -- production
